reports.title: Gulfport Energy Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results

lines: Dell’Osso continued, “We also continued to enhance the depth of our inventory, completing the Ohio state land acquisitions, and expect to complete our $140 million 2026 discretionary acreage acquisition program by year-end through disciplined, targeted leasing in the core of our position.
On October 30, 2026, Gulfport completed its semi-annual borrowing base redetermination, which reaffirmed both the borrowing base and elected commitments at $1.1 billion.
